queries.sql: SELECT cause, ROUND(AVG(outcome_rating), 2) AS avg_outcome_rating FROM disruption_cases dc JOIN resolutions r ON dc.id = r.case_id GROUP BY cause ORDER BY avg_outcome_rating ASC LIMIT 200
